data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to create customizable OTP and PIN input fields.
data.what_it_does: Provides an OTP text field widget allowing developers to specify length, field width, styles, and callbacks for completion. Supports quick paste functionality, controllers, input formatters, and backspace handling.
use_when: You need to build a verification screen or PIN entry form.
You want automatic focus management across multiple text input boxes for OTP codes.
avoid_when: You require complex form validation systems that are better handled by full form-building libraries.
strengths: Supports quick paste and controller management.
Customizable field appearance (underline, box style, colors, background color).
Handles backspace navigation between fields automatically.
weaknesses: Field layout is always left-to-right, which may impact right-to-left localization requirements.
